mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a Full Moon shining bright, though please be aware that the air quality index is at 51.

The City of Verona has launched a rain barrel rebate program providing a 30 dollar utility credit for qualifying installations, and don't forget that community voting for the student I Voted sticker contest is open until August 7.

We have a busy schedule today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company, plus live music continues tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report regarding local incidents, on July 25, a 29-year-old woman was arrested for a first-offence O W I.
The delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Turtle. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Raspberry Cheesecake.
